tagline: Leading electricity distribution company serving the northern Buenos Aires metropolitan area
hero_kpi_rationale: SAIDI (average interruption duration per customer) is the key operational performance KPI for electricity distributors. It directly reflects service quality and network reliability, a major driver of customer satisfaction and tariff regulation.

kpis.name: Service interruption duration per customer (SAIDI)
kpis.explanation: Average number of hours of electricity interruption per customer per year.
kpis.description: SAIDI measures electrical network reliability. A decrease in SAIDI indicates improved service continuity.

kpis.name: Average interruption duration (CAIDI)
kpis.explanation: Average duration of an electrical outage once it occurs.
kpis.description: CAIDI reflects response speed to outages. Low CAIDI means efficient interruption management.

kpis.name: Number of customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of customers served by Edenor at year-end.
kpis.description: Indicator of served market size covering the northern area of the Buenos Aires metropolitan region. Stable over recent period.
kpis.signal: Stable customer base in a mature market

kpis.name: Annual infrastructure investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in the electrical network and infrastructure.
kpis.description: Investments aim to improve service quality, continuity, and electrical network resilience.
kpis.signal: Support for network modernization and resilience

kpis.name: Direct CO2 emissions (Scope 1)
kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions from direct company sources (vehicles, facilities).
kpis.description: Direct emissions are limited to vehicles and own operational facilities.
kpis.signal: Low direct footprint as electricity is distributed, not produced

kpis.name: Indirect CO2 emissions related to electricity (Scope 2)
kpis.explanation: Emissions related to company electricity consumption for operations.
kpis.description: Measures indirect carbon footprint of offices, operational centers, and facilities.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 5759.38 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1192.73 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Training hours per employee
kpis.explanation: Average number of training hours received per employee each year.
kpis.description: Indicator of human capital and investment in employee personal development.

kpis.name: Share of women in workforce
kpis.explanation: Proportion of women among total employees.
kpis.description: Measures inclusion and gender diversity within the organization.

risks.title: Government intervention in the electricity sector
risks.score_rationale: Risk is at the top of the 10-K list, mentioned with strong language ("may continue to intervene"). Trend is stable but critical, as the State plays a central role in tariff regulation and regulatory credits. This category is central to Edenor's business model.

risks.title: Electricity shortages affecting distribution
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned with direct operational impact. Language is concerned ("act as a brake", "material penalties"). Trend is stable but recurring. High weight as linked to service capacity and sanctions.

risks.title: Dependence on delayed tariff adjustments
risks.score_rationale: Central position in report, strong language ("material adverse effect", "timely manner or at all"). Trend increasing in concern. Critical category as distribution costs rise with inflation, but tariffs do not follow.

risks.title: Energy losses and electricity theft
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as material risk. Direct language ("adversely affected"). Trend stable but persistent. Direct impact on operating margin and service quality.

risks.title: Illegal constructions in the concession area
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk mentioned with concrete consequences (safety, distribution). Language is concerned. Trend stable. High operational and safety impact.

risks.title: Cyberattacks on information systems
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in business risks. Strong language ("adversely affect business, financial condition"). Trend increasing with digitalization. Growing risk for critical infrastructure.

risks.title: Exclusivity threatened by technological evolution
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as future risk, moderate language ("may be adversely affected"). Trend increasing with rise of decentralized energy. Less immediate but strategically important.

risks.title: Dependence on equipment imports
risks.score_rationale: Specific supply chain risk. Clear language ("material adverse effect"). Trend stable. Critical for investment plan and concession compliance.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2025 sustainability report. Technology strategy focuses on electrical network modernization and service quality.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation
Absence of digital projects or AI-related technology innovation
Focus on traditional network management and customer satisfaction
